title: Local scientific outcomes do not justify a blanket representation prompt
statement: Across four retained initial states, twelve continuations and two task families, ordinary warmW, ordinary freshF and equally fresh plus representation procedureR produced complementary scoped results. The completed source-exposed math/control reviews and unmasked mapping show no consistent added-procedure winner. Fresh ordinary equals or improves some common constructions, while warm/procedure contexts retain different valid restrictions and barriers. This is scoped research-method evidence, not a discovery-policy guarantee. The common positive heat coefficient is counted once, safe-mean and boundary-field results retain distinct quantifiers, and scalar/fixed-word/action-tail control barriers remain incomparable. The original prompts and arm mapping permit source-level interpretation; active post-comparison transfer attempts are not outcomes of the frozen experiment.
